scope: Proposition 5.2 (The label budget) of the manuscript “No bigeodesics in planar first-passage percolation” (preprints/No-bigeodesics-in-planar-first-passage-percolation-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 212 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f97d87dc82bcee0c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a bin (α, β)I, an integer spacing l ≥ 1, and a gain b > 0. On a common probability space, mark some sites of the horizontal grid kj = (jl, 0), j ∈ Z. Suppose all sites have the same marginal probability qα,β of being marked in this bin, and the base environment has its usual fixed-label Busemann asymptotics. Suppose also that for successive marks k < y in the bin the comparison (39) holds. In particular, this is so if the hypotheses of Theorem 5.1 hold with common deterministic bounds and successive marks are sufficiently separated. Then (42) b l qα,β ≤ r(β) − r(α). No independence or ergodicity assumption on the marks is needed.
